name: Can I remove a decomposing animal smell myself?

mainEntity.name: Can I remove a decomposing animal smell myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: For small, easily accessible dead animals, you might be able to remove the carcass yourself using gloves and dispose of it properly. However, simply removing the animal isn't always enough, as residual odors can linger. You'll need to thoroughly clean and disinfect the affected area. If the animal is inaccessible (e.g., inside a wall), or if the smell persists after cleaning, professional help is recommended to avoid further issues and ensure complete odor elimination.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can remove small, accessible animals yourself, but ensure thorough cleaning. For inaccessible sources or persistent odors, professional help is recommended.
